tools.name: find_subreddits
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which subreddits or Reddit communities fit a product, brand or niche, or where on Reddit AI answers look for recommendations in a category. Takes a short description such as "AI writing tool for marketers" and returns up to 10 matching subreddits, closest match first, with how often AI answers cited each, members and a link to each subreddit's data page. Only subreddits in CommunityMentions' data (cited 50+ times or with 50+ verified comments placed) are included; health, legal-help and adult communities are left out.

description.description: What the product or niche is, in a few words

tools.name: get_subreddit
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how often AI answers cite a specific subreddit, which of its threads get cited, or whether it matters for being recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini. Takes a subreddit name such as "SaaS" or "r/marketing" and returns its AI citations by engine, the kinds of questions those answers were about, its most-cited threads and its member count.

subreddit.description: A subreddit name, with or without r/
